name: http-c2pa-wasm
description: Simple c2pa service that prints a manifest

scripts.build: cargo build --release && jco componentize dist/http-c2pa.js --wit ../wit/ --world-name c2pa-webserver --out c2pa-node.wasm && wac plug ../target/wasm32-wasip2/release/c2pa_component.wasm --plug ../target/wasm32-wasip2/release/signer.wasm -o c2pa_component.wasm && wac plug c2pa-node.wasm --plug c2pa_component.wasm -o c2pa-node-fused.wasm
scripts.all: npm run compile && npm run build
